key_facts: Lighthouses were crucial for maritime navigation before the advent of modern technologies like GPS
Radio communication was a primary means of contact between ships and coastal authorities until the mid-20th century
There have been numerous instances of ships disappearing at sea without explanation throughout history
Old radios can sometimes pick up distant or weak signals that are not audible on newer devices
